candidates.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
candidates.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

candidates.title: Use decision models with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations
candidates.summary: Some agent-evaluation questions are narrow and repeatable, and decision models answer exactly that kind of question. This post shows how to connect two decision models, Jev and Strands Decider, to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations through code-based evaluators, and how to validate a decision-model check before you gate a release on it.

candidates.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
candidates.summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.

candidates.title: Four layers of context engineering for production AI agents: How Deep Insight applies them in working code
candidates.summary: In production AI agents, context management is the real bottleneck. This post presents a four-layer context engineering framework (architecture, prompts, file-based tools, and verification agents), implemented in working code from Deep Insight, an open source multi-agent data analysis solution on the Strands Agents SDK and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

candidates.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
candidates.summary: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

candidates.title: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
candidates.summary: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.
